description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for handling leave-related database operations in an Android app using Room persistence library. It declares methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting leave data.

classes.name: LeaveDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for performing database operations related to leaves.

methods.name: getAllLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves all leave entries from the database.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Fetches leaves within a specified time period based on start and end timestamps.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leaves modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts a new leave entry into the database, replacing conflicts.

methods.name: deleteLeaveById
methods.description: Deletes a leave entry identified by its ID.
